dataset_story: This dataset provides a set of hand-crafted features extracted from website HTML and URLs to identify phishing attempts. AURA uses it to feed the Phishing Risk provider.
aura_purpose: Used to identify malicious landing pages and credential harvesting sites.

citation.text: Mohammad, R. M., et al. (2012). An assessment of features related to phishing websites using an automated technique.

having_IP_Address.description: Whether the URL contains an IP address

URL_Length.description: Total length of the URL string
